unresolved: Supply every template parameter without a default; select and confirm the deployment account and region separately.
Build and independently verify a production Linux X86_64 image in ECR. Development npm/runserver images are not production evidence.
Verify VPC/subnet membership, HTTPS listener protocol, certificate/DNS, ALB security group, unique hostname rule and unused rule priority.
Verify private-subnet egress (NAT or ECR/S3/logs/secret[REDACTED] endpoints), execution-role access and separate least-privilege task-role trust.
Review all runtime variables and Secret[REDACTED] Manager mappings. No dotenv values are copied; aws-runtime.json lists names only.
Verify the readiness route returns 200 with ALB health-check Host headers; authentication must remain intact.
Review availability, scaling, CPU/memory, outbound rules, log retention and budget before a separate deployment review.
Use a production WSGI/ASGI server, DEBUG=False, appropriate ALLOWED_HOSTS/CSRF/proxy configuration and a static/media strategy.
Replace disposable SQLite/PostgreSQL with an explicitly reviewed durable database and backups. Plan migrations separately; no migration command is generated.

action.reason: User requested creation of the AWS preparation foundation; the proposal is ready, so applying it will generate the CloudFormation template, readiness report, and preparation documentation.

state.message: AWS preparation artifacts (aws-template.json, aws-readiness.json, AWS-PREPARATION.md) have been generated and written locally (session_id efbfeaedffd046c29f3d0f80eaea8f70). The proposal was marked ready, confirming the Django framework and an ECS Fargate / CloudFormation deployment target. Required CloudFormation parameters are VpcId, PrivateSubnetIds, AlbSecurityGroupId, HttpsListenerArn, Hostname, RulePriority, ImageUri, ExecutionRoleArn, TaskRoleArn, HealthPath, RuntimeSecret0Arn, RuntimeSecret1Arn. Production prerequisites include: building and verifying a production Linux x86_64 Docker image (push to ECR), replacing the disposable SQLite database with a durable, reviewed database, setting DEBUG=False, configuring ALLOWED_HOSTS, static/media handling, and ensuring proper IAM roles, VPC/subnet configuration, ALB listener and security group settings. No AWS resources have been created or account changes made.
